mechanism: Both agents are potentially nephrotoxic and hepatotoxic; amikacin is a nephrotoxic aminoglycoside and isotretinoin requires careful hepatic/renal monitoring, with additive risk of organ toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) and hepatic function (transaminases) regularly; ensure adequate hydration during amikacin therapy; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
